HOW TO PLAY

Four buttons.
Four legs.

Each button has a number. Find the same number on the horse.

Tap 1 → 4 → 2 → 3, then repeat. Aim for three taps a second. On a keyboard: Q → P → W → O.

Too fast? You trip. Too slow? You stop. Wrong leg? You tip over. The horse gets tired as you go.

Keep the balance dot near the middle. How far can you go?
